notes: Deadline for non-EU applicants: application period runs 16 January until 30 September for the winter semester; the year 2026 appears in the pages, but the deadline page states the period without a year, so the 2026 deadline may be the specific year of the page. The application channel is uni-assist (de-uni-assist), as stated for applicants with certificates from outside the EU/EEA and for this bachelor's programme. Tuition: the DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester None', but the semester contribution of approx. 320 EUR per semester is not tuition. The university pages state the programme is taught in German and the DAAD page adds English for the China double-degree part and the Bachelor's thesis; no documents were named in the provided pages, so no documents list is given.
